description: This file implements the ServiceAdministrator class within the Thunder::Core namespace, managing service registration, instantiation, and library unloading in a plugin-like architecture.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages service registration, instantiation, and library unloading within the Thunder::Core namespace.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers a service if not already registered.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates a service instance from a library if available.

methods.name: ReleaseLibrary
methods.description: Adds a library reference to the unreferenced libraries list for later unloading.

methods.name: FlushLibraries
methods.description: Unloads all unreferenced libraries, waiting for unload completion.
